ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-intensity to low-intensity ratio; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 8% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in scars and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes. Discontinuous high-intensity linear features (rake marks) distributed across central and mid-lobe regions. Focal high-intensity circular clusters (rosettes) located primarily on the right lobe and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees with a significant vertical depth extending toward the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. Notable deep notch (trauma-induced) located on the medial-posterior edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid-like curve, transitioning from convex at the tips to concave as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters, varying from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter, densely concentrated on the lower half of the right lobe and the far tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the ventral surface at multiple angles; most prominent on the central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; distinct traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible barnacle colonization creating high-intensity textured clusters on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant cluster of calcified protrusions (barnacles) localized on the outer margin of the right fluke tip, creating a jagged, non-organic pixel profile.
